notes: Source-provenance golden fixtures for kraken_spot (XBT/USD). Frames follow the official Kraken WebSocket v1 docs (trade + book channels; connector subscribes to book depth 1000). Expected events are the normalized connector output pinned by hand from the documented semantics below and verified by driving the real KrakenSpotConnector parser.

sources.note: Trade message: [channelID, [ [price, volume, time, side, orderType, misc], ... ], 'trade', pair]. Docs example [0, [["5541.20000","0.15850568","1534614057.321597","s","l",""], ["6060.00000","0.02455000","1534614057.324998","b","l",""]], "trade", "XBT/USD"]. time is UNIX epoch in SECONDS; side 'b'=buy / 's'=sell; the v1 trade stream carries no per-trade id.

semantics.side: entry[3] is the trade side: 'b' -> 'buy', 's' -> 'sell' (direct mapping — v1 trade reports the side, not a maker flag)
semantics.trade_id: no exchange trade id in v1: composite '<time>-<price>-<qty>-<orderType>-<misc>' concatenating the raw wire strings, pinned exactly

sources.note: Book messages: [channelID, {as/bs} | {a/b/c}, 'book-<depth>', pair]. Docs snapshot example [0, {as:[[price,volume,ts],...], bs:[...]}, 'book-100', 'XBT/USD'] — the docs state 'there is no checksum on the snapshot'. Update docs example [1234, {a:[['5541.30000','2.50700000','1534614248.456738']], c:'974942666'}, 'book-10', 'XBT/USD']. Level rows are [price, volume, timestamp]; volume '0.00000000' deletes the level.

semantics.side: n/a (bs=bid levels, as=ask levels on snapshot; b=bid rows, a=ask rows on update)
semantics.ts_field: none — book frames carry no exchange event time (level rows carry a per-level last-change ts, unused); emitted ts is the local processing time with source_event_ts_ms=null / source_event_time_known=false / event_time_source='local'
semantics.checksum: c field (CRC32 of the top-10 book) is passed through on the emitted event; validation only engages once BOTH sides hold >= 10 levels. Fixture books stay below that threshold so the hand-pinned frames are checksum-neutral and c is pinned as passthrough.
semantics.level_rows: [price, volume, timestamp] wire rows are reduced to [price, volume] string pairs; the row timestamp is dropped
